memory_update.text: AMSC is the cleanest US-listed underfollowed candidate for the FACTS/STATCOM portion of the HVDC/FACTS/grid-stability node; verify current grid-segment revenue, D-VAR backlog, and utility/renewable order cadence in latest filings.

PLPC is a small-cap transmission/substation hardware candidate with strong second-order grid-buildout relevance, but direct HVDC/FACTS linkage is unproven and must be verified through product specs, utility standards, and project references.

POWL belongs in the underfollowed second-order lane because its engineered substations, E-Houses, switchgear, and control systems overlap utility/industrial electrification; direct HVDC/FACTS customer exposure remains an evidence gap.
GE Vernova should be used as a reference anchor and supplier-map source for this node, not as the alpha-hunting target, because it is a mega-cap high-attention direct grid leader.

US-listed pure-play suppliers of HVDC reactors, harmonic filters, and instrument transformers appear scarce from this pass; many purer component suppliers may be non-US-listed, private, or embedded inside larger OEMs.

node: HVDC, FACTS, reactors, harmonic filters, instrument transformers, and grid-stability components
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the HVDC/FACTS/grid-stability component node using a two-lane funnel. GE Vernova is retained only as a reference anchor because it is a direct HVDC/FACTS/grid-solutions leader but mega-cap and high-attention. The underfollowed discovery lane contains smaller or mid-sized US-listed companies with plausible direct or second-order exposure: AMSC for STATCOM/FACTS voltage-support systems, PLPC for transmission/substation hardware and conductor protection used in grid buildout, and POWL for engineered electrical power distribution/control systems serving utilities and industrial electrification. Evidence strength is highest for AMSC and GEV as direct node participants; PLPC and POWL are included as second-order chokepoint-adjacent candidates requiring project/customer-level verification.
